facts.claim: 我事先在谷歌图片上搜过 Denny Peters，想提前压掉对他的欲望
facts.quote: I’d even stooped to Google Imaging him beforehand

facts.claim: 我十八岁时把与父母的决裂正式化，法定改了名字
facts.quote: I made the estrangement official by legally changing my name

facts.claim: 我对 Denny 说如今自己叫 Belle
Denny 打断我的道歉，脱口说自己已经订婚
我端杯掩饰时把半杯茶洒在自己裤子上
facts.quote: Maybe this is why I spilled half its contents in my lap.

facts.claim: Denny 说他和 Abi 是在慈善活动上帮她找鞋而相识
facts.quote: she lost her shoe and was looking all over for it

facts.claim: Denny 说未婚妻 Abi 对我有个提议
Denny 说 Genevieve 全家周末聚会撒她母亲的骨灰
facts.quote: They’re scattering her ashes, and her whole family is going to be there

relations.rel: 旧情人：我甩了他，如今后悔并想复合
relations.quote: I regret the way I ended things between us
her best friend was Genevieve Caraway

relations.rel: 传闻中的代笔合作对象；我是她的读者
relations.quote: Genevieve Caraway was looking to break out of the self-help genre.

relations.rel: 他曾是这位政客的保镖之一（当时也雇了我）
relations.quote: one of the bodyguards for Dorothy Gibson

relations.rel: 唯一的手足，二十五年前自杀身亡
relations.quote: I lost my sister to suicide

numbers.claim: 妹妹自杀、我失去唯一手足的时间
numbers.quote: Twenty-five years ago, when I was still a teenager

numbers.claim: 上次见 Denny 以来我遇到过的尸体数
他额头上惊出的三道平行皱纹
numbers.quote: his smooth forehead acquiring three perfect, parallel lines

numbers.claim: 吐司架上至少六个三角形吐司“角”
numbers.quote: at least half a dozen triangular toast
I got four tiny pots of it

numbers.claim: Genevieve 被持刀威胁时的年龄
Genevieve 遭囚禁折磨的时长
她历年出版的自助类书名目数
numbers.quote: at least half a dozen self-help titles

numbers.claim: 我说佩服别人时心口不一的比例
numbers.quote: unlike ninety-nine percent of the time

numbers.claim: Abi 与 Denny 相识的年份
numbers.quote: Abi and I met last year
Her mom passed away at the end of last year
a bright and sunny afternoon in the middle of May
They’re spreading the ashes on Friday night.

numbers.claim: 我为赶上葬礼须完成签约并飞犹他的剩余时间
numbers.quote: I had less than two days

numbers.value: the next two days at least
numbers.claim: Denny 被生意绊住纽约的时长
numbers.quote: I have business keeping me here for the next two days at least.

turning_point: Denny 抢白说出自己已订婚，堵死我的复合告白，随后转达未婚妻 Abi 的提议：请我去犹他州为 Genevieve Caraway 代笔回忆录。
notes: 叙述者本章始终未被点出原姓名（只说她更偏爱本名，‘Belle Currer’ 是写小说用的笔名）；妹妹自杀、父母疏远、改名均以回忆概述给出，无具体日期。Dorothy Gibson 此处仅称 politician，且曾同时雇佣我与 Denny。
